content.text: `/tmp` isn't writable in this environment, so I'll rerun the example using the workspace `tmp` directory.

arguments.command: cd /app && python3 submission/main.py < examples/input.json > tmp/actual.json; python3 -c 'import json; a=json.load(open("tmp/actual.json")); e=json.load(open("examples/expected.json")); print(a==e); print(json.dumps(a)[:900]) if a!=e else None'
